<script>
const target = new Date("2026-10-10T17:00:00+03:00").getTime();

function countdown(){
  const x=Math.max(0,target-Date.now());
  document.getElementById("d").textContent=Math.floor(x/86400000);
  document.getElementById("h").textContent=String(Math.floor(x/3600000)%24).padStart(2,"0");
  document.getElementById("m").textContent=String(Math.floor(x/60000)%60).padStart(2,"0");
  document.getElementById("s").textContent=String(Math.floor(x/1000)%60).padStart(2,"0");
}
countdown(); setInterval(countdown,1000);

let inviteOpened = false;

function openInvite(){
  if(inviteOpened) return;
  inviteOpened = true;
  const env=document.getElementById("envelope");
  env.classList.add("open");
  setTimeout(()=>{
    document.getElementById("intro").classList.add("hide");
    document.body.classList.remove("lock");
    document.getElementById("musicBtn").classList.add("show");
    fireworks();
    petals();
    startMusic();
  },850);
}

// Open the invitation automatically one second after the page loads.
setTimeout(openInvite, 1000);

function fireworks(){
  const box=document.getElementById("particles");
  // Gentle falling sparkles for ~18 seconds, rather than a short upward burst.
  for(let i=0;i<110;i++){
    const p=document.createElement("i"); p.className="spark";
    p.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+"%";
    p.style.top=(-8-Math.random()*18)+"%";
    p.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*8)+"s";
    p.style.animationDuration=(15+Math.random()*4)+"s";
    p.style.opacity=(0.55+Math.random()*0.45).toFixed(2);
    box.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),26000);
  }
}

function petals(){
  const box=document.getElementById("petals");
  for(let i=0;i<32;i++){
    const p=document.createElement("i"); p.className="petal";
    p.style.left=(Math.random()*100)+"%";
    p.style.setProperty("--drift",(Math.random()*220-110)+"px");
    p.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*5)+"s";
    p.style.animationDuration=(7+Math.random()*7)+"s";
    p.style.transform="rotate("+Math.random()*360+"deg)";
    box.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),15000);
  }
}

const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add("visible")
}),{threshold:.13});
document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(x=>io.observe(x));



const bgMusic = document.getElementById("bgMusic");
let musicOn = false;

// Keep the uploaded Wedding 01 track at exactly 50% player volume.
bgMusic.volume = 0.50;
bgMusic.muted = false;

async function startMusic(){
  bgMusic.volume = 0.50;
  try{
    await bgMusic.play();
    musicOn = true;
    document.getElementById("musicBtn").textContent = "❚❚";
    return true;
  }catch(e){
    // iOS Safari may block audible autoplay. The first normal tap anywhere
    // on the invitation will start it at the same 50% volume.
    musicOn = false;
    document.getElementById("musicBtn").textContent = "♫";
    return false;
  }
}

function stopMusic(){
  bgMusic.pause();
  musicOn = false;
  document.getElementById("musicBtn").textContent = "♫";
}

function toggleMusic(){
  if(musicOn) stopMusic();
  else startMusic();
}

// Fallback for iPhone/iPad autoplay restrictions: any first interaction
// with the page starts the music, so users do not need to find the music button.
["touchstart","pointerdown","click"].forEach(evt=>{
  document.addEventListener(evt,()=>{
    if(!musicOn) startMusic();
  },{once:true,passive:true});
});
</script>
